//: Standalone build for the headless worker runtime. The main `tsc` build emits a deep dist/ tree because orchestrate.ts/types.ts import across the package boundary (src/planning/orchestration), which pulls tsc's rootDir up to the repo root. The worker subgraph (spawn-agent-cli + coordination) has no such imports, so it builds flat here to dist-worker/ and is spawned from there by spawn-agents.ts.
